steps.content: The deck lies in wreck. Half the equipment that once packed every corner is gone, while the rest lies smashed to pieces. Several crew members huddle around Captain Edmond, their voices shaken as they count the survivors.

steps.speaker: Captain Edmond
steps.content: Is this everyone? Where are the others? Weren't you supposed to be wearing tethers?!

steps.speaker: Crew Member
steps.content: It was no use... The wave was too big. Once they went overboard, the line snapped before we could pull them up... We only made it because we were clinging to the mast.
The crewman is soaked to the bone and looks like a mess. Contamination from the sea has spread across his body. He may have survived, but not unscathed.
The captain breathes heavily, fists clenching and unclenching at his side.
He's your captain. And at times like this, everyone needs him more than ever.

steps.speaker: Captain Edmond
steps.content: I'll check the other sections. There might be more who went overboard.

steps.speaker: Captain Edmond
steps.content: Find a way to reach Pylgia. See if she can find any sign of our people underwater.
